verdict.rationale: DeepInfra's docs describe itself as a drop-in OpenAI replacement with an OpenAI-compatible chat completions API. Switching only requires changing base_url, api_key and model, with no other code changes, so an agent can swap to or away from it using standard OpenAI-style calls. Extensions such as service_tier and fail_fast are optional. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that agents switch mid-workflow without compatibility issues.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have an agent switch to or away from this provider mid-workflow because it speaks the standard chat-completions API without provider-specific code changes

citations.quote: Drop-in OpenAI replacement. Point your existing OpenAI SDK to https://api.deepinfra.com/v1/openai and your code works without changes.
OpenAI-compatible chat completions API — just change the base URL and model name.
